name: AWS Serverless IaC Guard
description: Protects AWS serverless deployment tooling: teardown of CDK/SAM/Serverless Framework/Amplify stacks, and deploys that skip the normal confirmation/diff-review step straight into production. Complements Terraform Baseline/Extended and IaC Guard, which do not cover these CLIs.

rules.name: Require access request for cdk destroy
rules.description: cdk destroy tears down every resource in the stack. Preview with 'cdk diff' first.

rules.name: Require access request for sam delete
rules.description: sam delete removes the deployed CloudFormation stack and, unless --no-prompts is overridden, its artifacts bucket. Irreversible.

rules.name: Require access request for serverless remove
rules.description: serverless remove (or its sls alias) deletes the entire deployed service — all functions, API Gateway resources, and the CloudFormation stack.

rules.name: Require access request for amplify delete
rules.description: amplify delete removes the entire Amplify project and all its backend resources. Irreversible.

rules.name: Require justification for amplify remove category
rules.description: amplify remove <category> deletes a configured backend resource (auth, api, storage, function, etc.) from the project.

rules.name: Require justification for cdk deploy skip approval
rules.description: cdk deploy --require-approval never skips the manual review of IAM/security-group changes before deploying — verify the diff was reviewed some other way.

rules.name: Require justification for sam deploy skip confirmation
rules.description: sam deploy --no-confirm-changeset skips the changeset review step, deploying whatever SAM generated without a human checking it first.

rules.name: Warn on serverless deploy to prod stage
rules.description: serverless/sls deploy --stage prod (or production) deploys directly to the production stage.

rules.name: Warn on sam sync to prod stack
rules.description: sam sync bypasses the normal CloudFormation changeset flow for fast dev-loop deploys. Running it against a stack whose name contains 'prod' pushes unreviewed code straight to production.

rules.name: Warn on amplify push skip confirmation
rules.description: amplify push --yes (or -y) skips the review-then-confirm prompt before pushing backend changes to the cloud.
